description: This file contains extension methods for configuring and enhancing the Orleans silo builder, including clustering setup, activity propagation, and distributed grain directory registration.

classes.name: CoreHostingExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure Orleans silo features.

methods.name: AddActivityPropagation
methods.description: Adds activity propagation filters to the silo builder for distributed tracing.

methods.name: UseLocalhostClustering
methods.description: Configures the silo to use development clustering on localhost with specified ports and optional primary silo endpoint.

methods.name: UseDevelopmentClustering
methods.description: Configures the silo for development-only clustering with optional primary silo endpoint or custom options.

methods.name: AddDistributedGrainDirectory
methods.description: Registers the distributed grain directory implementation with the silo builder, optionally as the default directory.
